evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: A directive that sets cadence by fiat and frames non-compliance as loss of capability — hierarchy enacted through command and consequence.
Records the mandated cadence as a fixed attribute — the directive's authority preserved in summary form.
Assigns a single named owner — rank-based allocation of responsibility, the directive's hierarchy made concrete.
